{{dablink|For other uses of the words "four" and "stone," see [[Four]] and [[Stone]].}}
The '''Four Stones''' is a [[sept]] of the [[Taardad]] [[Aiel]]. The sept hold is unknown. On their way to [[Alcair Dal]], [[Rand al'Thor]] and the [[Jindo]] are joined by other Taardad septs including the [[Nine Valleys]], [[Chumai]], Four Stones, [[Bloody Water]] and [[Miadi]] septs.{{ref/book|4|57}}
